description: Client-side script for handling the UI interactions of the 'Bank Statement Import' doctype in ERPNext. It manages setup, real-time updates, file import preview, status indicators, and user actions related to bank statement import processes.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup of event handlers for real-time updates, file queries, and import preview configuration.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form UI, updates indicators, and adjusts buttons based on document status.

methods.name: onload_post_render
methods.description: Actions to perform after form load and rendering, primarily updating primary action button.

methods.name: update_primary_action
methods.description: Enables or disables the primary action button based on form's dirty state and import conditions.

methods.name: update_indicators
methods.description: Sets the status indicator on the form page based on the document's indicator info.

methods.name: show_import_status
methods.description: Displays a message about the success or partial success of import operations, based on import_log.

methods.name: show_report_error_button
methods.description: Adds a 'Report Error' button if there is an error in the import document, enabling error reporting.

methods.name: start_import
methods.description: Triggers the start of the import process via server call.

methods.name: download_template
methods.description: Downloads a template file for importing bank transactions.

methods.name: reference_doctype
methods.description: Handles updates when the reference doctype is changed, toggles submit button accordingly.

methods.name: toggle_submit_after_import
methods.description: Shows or hides the 'submit after import' option based on the doctype's submittability.

methods.name: google_sheets_url
methods.description: Handles changes to the Google Sheets URL input, triggering import preview update.

methods.name: refresh_google_sheet
methods.description: Refreshes import preview when Google Sheet URL is updated.

methods.name: import_file
methods.description: Loads and displays an import file or Google Sheets data preview, initializes import preview component.

methods.name: show_import_preview
methods.description: Displays a preview of the import data, initializing the import preview component.

methods.name: show_import_warnings
methods.description: Displays warnings related to import data, grouped by rows or columns.

methods.name: show_failed_logs
methods.description: Triggers display of failed import logs.

methods.name: show_import_log
methods.description: Renders the import log details, success/failure information, and traceback traceback buttons.

methods.name: export_errored_rows
methods.description: Exports rows with errors to a file for correction.
